html-minifier 4.0.0 — MIT (Copyright (c) 2010-2018 Juriy "kangax" Zaytsev)
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html-minifier@4.0.0/LICENSE (raw-verified 2026-08-31)

Bundled dependencies (logic unmodified, bundled by esbuild for the browser):
  clean-css 4.2.x — MIT (Jakub Pawlowicz)
  he 1.2.x — MIT (Mathias Bynens)
  relateurl 0.2.x — MIT (Steven Vachon)
  camel-case 3.x — MIT (Blake Embrey)
  param-case 2.x — MIT (Blake Embrey)
  uglify-js 3.x — BSD-2-Clause (Mihai Bazon)
  uglify-js browser bootstrap replicates its own tools/node.js self-build,
  minus the node:fs file reads.

Node built-ins (fs/http/https/url) are stubbed and path/os minimally shimmed:
they sit on clean-css's remote-import and URL-rebase code paths, which are
never reached when minifying pasted text (no inline:remote, no rebase).

Bundle built with: esbuild --bundle --format=iife --global-name=HTMLMinifier
Entry: module.exports = require("html-minifier")
